messages:
incident-bot: PAGED @oncall: High tail latency detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2) — 5xxs + 95th latency > 2s. Pager ID: PGR-2026-0317-01 :rotating_light:
Maya: Ack, looking. taking bridge now.
Kevin: Oncall here, joining. any visible deploys?
Maya: No deploys in last 30m. I see spike correlated with batcher queue depth rising in rtm-gpu-4 pool.
Raj: Jumping in to check kernel fallback logs. pulling kvcache metrics.
Maya: Mitigation: scaled up dedicated pool by +2 nodes, drained rtm-gpu-4 -> new pool. Starting prefix cache warmup.
Kevin: Noted. routing policy switched to fallback-small-quantized, should reduce latency but may increase cost.
Emily: CS here — any customer-facing impact? Which customers saw 5xxs?
Maya: Quick list: acme-inc (some 5xxs), buildbot (rate-limited errors), others mostly timeouts. Sending export to #support for outreach.
Luis: I pushed a temp queuing throttling patch to reduce head-of-line blocking: small change, feature flag off by default.
Raj: Kernel fallback logs show OOM spikes around 13:12:22 UTC. Looks like a quantization path mismatched with sequence-length distribution; fallback triggered and increased memory.
Maya: Confirmed, memory thrash caused GC spikes, then request latencies climbed.
Kevin: Bridge: mitigation standing. observing 95p back to normal after scale + routing.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — Pager PGR-2026-0317-01 resolved at 13:18:00 UTC. Root cause: memory thrash leading to kernel fallback under unusual seq-length distribution.
Maya: Filing postmortem. Who can own RCA draft and timeline? Prefer an infra owner + ML runtime reviewer.
Raj: I can own the draft for contributing technical factors.
Emily: I'll own customer impact section + outreach timeline.
Luis: I'll add mitigation steps and the small patch details.
Kevin: I'll do remediation tracking and rollout plan for a robust fallback gating.
Maya: Great. Proposed schedule: RCA draft ready EOD tomorrow, internal peer review day after, legal/compliance check + signoff in 3 days, public postmortem + customer notes in 5 days. Thoughts?
Emily: Sounds good. We should block a 30m sync for walkthrough before peer review.
Kevin: Add QE for reproducer tests — we need an automated seq-length fuzz test. Assigning to sara. Sara?
Sara: Got it, will add test and target 48h for initial harness.
Maya: Action items (quick list):
- Raj: timeline + technical root cause draft (EOD +1)
- Luis: mitigation patch notes + revert plan (EOD +1)
- Kevin: remediation roadmap + rollout gating (EOD +2)
- Emily: customer impact + outreach draft (EOD +1)
- Sara: QE reproducer harness (48h)
- Maya: schedule 30m walkthrough for draft review (tomorrow 10:30am PT)
Please update the shared doc: https://redwood.atlassian/pm/rca/PGR-2026-0317-01 (draft in progress).
Raj: Quick note for timeline section in doc: include exact timestamps, request ids, and links to kernel logs. I'll add a script output snippet.
Luis: Putting the patch diff in the doc — will include commands to rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/rtm-gpu-4` and the feature flag toggle.
Emily: I'll draft the customer note template and flag any customers requiring legal review.
Kevin: After peer review, can someone from infra sign off on the remediation schedule? Maya?
Maya: Yes, I'll sign off once QE passes the reproducer and we have a rollout window.
Sara: Starting the harness now, will post progress to this thread.
Raj: Drafting timeline now, will ping when ready for walkthrough.
Maya: Thanks team. Once draft is in, please add reviewer comments inline. We'll aim to close this with sign-off by Friday. :thumbsup:
